主要内容: On August 7, 2018, Mr. Steven E. Swain notified DISH Network Corporation and its wholly-owned subsidiary, DISH DBS Corporation, that he was resigning as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of each of DISH Network and DISH DBS, effective August 22, 2018. Mr. Swain has also served as principal financial officer of both DISH Network and DISH DBS. Also on August 7, 2018, the Boards of Directors of DISH Network and DISH DBS designated Paul W. Orban as the principal financial officer of each of DISH Network and DISH DBS, effective August 22, 2018.
